mandates.purpose: Produce the quarterly report for internal review
Publish an approved release to the public
The agent's own upkeep: index and read documents it maintains
Annotate, summarize or translate a draft for oneself
Export or archive a document for oneself
Change the configuration of the realm

revocations.reason: scheduled end of bob's annotation delegation

prohibitions.reason: the publishing bot may only stage, never release publicly
carol's documents are under legal hold
ops-bot is frozen during the audit (written with the wrong principal kind)

scenarios.name: a01-cd-own-authority-own-purpose
scenarios.description: research-agent, with its own token, reads q3-report for its own upkeep (agent-maintenance) using its own reader grant.

scenarios.name: a02-cd-own-token-samanthas-purpose
scenarios.description: research-agent, with its own token, reads q3-report claiming samantha's purpose (generate-report). Its own grant is not usable under that mandate; samantha's delegation needs a token proving it acts for her.

scenarios.name: a03-cd-for-samantha-her-purpose
scenarios.description: research-agent acts for samantha and reads q3-report under generate-report, through her delegation.

scenarios.name: a04-cd-for-samantha-agents-purpose
scenarios.description: research-agent acts for samantha but claims its own purpose (agent-maintenance). Neither its own grant (wrong path) nor her delegation (wrong mandate) applies.

scenarios.name: a05-cd-pure-deputy
scenarios.description: research-agent acts for samantha and indexes q3-report, a capability only the agent itself holds. The classic confused deputy.

scenarios.name: a06-cd-for-bob
scenarios.description: research-agent acts for bob and reads bob-notes through bob's own delegation.

scenarios.name: a07-cd-no-cross-subject-substitution
scenarios.description: research-agent acts for bob and reads q3-report. Bob's q3 delegation was revoked; samantha's live q3 delegation must not substitute.

scenarios.name: a08-stale-expired-parent-live-child
scenarios.description: research-agent acts for samantha and annotates q3-report. Samantha's root expired on 2026-09-01; the delegated child claims validity until the end of 2026.

scenarios.name: a09-stale-child-starts-before-parent
scenarios.description: research-agent acts for samantha and summarizes q3-report. The child claims validity from 2026-05-01, before its parent's 2026-06-01.

scenarios.name: a10-stale-revoked-root-live-delegation
scenarios.description: research-agent acts for bob and generates bob-notes. Bob's root generate grant was revoked; the delegation below it is unrevoked.

scenarios.name: a11-stale-revoked-middle-link
scenarios.description: summarizer-agent acts for carol via planner-agent and generates q3-report. The middle link (planner-agent's delegation) was revoked.

scenarios.name: a12-stale-anchor-removed-depth3
scenarios.description: As a19, but the live role mappings show carol no longer holds report-author.

scenarios.name: a13-stale-future-dated-revocation
scenarios.description: research-agent acts for bob and annotates bob-notes. The delegation's revocation is dated 2027-01-01, after evaluated_at: the model treats a listed revocation as effective (the date is not consulted).

scenarios.name: a14-stale-exactly-valid-from
scenarios.description: As a03 at exactly the delegation's valid_from (inclusive).

scenarios.name: a15-stale-one-second-before-valid-from
scenarios.description: As a03 one second before the delegation's valid_from.

scenarios.name: a16-stale-one-second-before-valid-until
scenarios.description: As a03 one second before the delegation's valid_until.

scenarios.name: a17-stale-exactly-valid-until
scenarios.description: As a03 at exactly the delegation's valid_until (exclusive).

scenarios.name: a18-chain-depth2-matches
scenarios.description: summarizer-agent acts for carol via planner-agent (act = summarizer{act = planner}) and reads q3-report: carol -> planner -> summarizer.

scenarios.name: a19-chain-depth3-matches
scenarios.description: research-agent acts for carol via summarizer-agent and planner-agent and reads q3-report: carol -> planner -> summarizer -> research-agent.

scenarios.name: a20-chain-reversed
scenarios.description: The actor chain of a18 reversed: planner-agent is the current actor.

scenarios.name: a21-chain-skips-a-hop
scenarios.description: research-agent acts for carol via planner-agent only; the ledger chain goes through summarizer-agent.

scenarios.name: a22-chain-depth-exceeded
scenarios.description: summarizer-agent acts for carol via planner-agent and annotates q3-report. Carol's root has delegable_depth 1, so planner-agent could not delegate further.

scenarios.name: a23-chain-cycle
scenarios.description: planner-agent acts for summarizer-agent and indexes q3-report with grants that delegate to each other (A -> B -> A) and have no root.

scenarios.name: a24-chain-unregistered-middle-named
scenarios.description: research-agent acts for carol via ghost-agent, which holds the middle link but is not in ledger.principals.

scenarios.name: a25-chain-unregistered-middle-omitted
scenarios.description: As a24 with ghost-agent omitted from the token.

scenarios.name: a26-contra-live-and-revoked-twin
scenarios.description: samantha publishes q3-report. One of her two publish grants is revoked; the other authorizes (grants combine permissively).

scenarios.name: a27-contra-prohibition-beats-grant
scenarios.description: publisher-bot publishes q3-report publicly with a valid grant; a prohibition forbids it public disclosure.

scenarios.name: a28-contra-subject-prohibition-binds-actor
scenarios.description: research-agent acts for carol and shares q3-report with the organization. Carol is prohibited from disclosure to the organization or wider.

scenarios.name: a29-contra-org-prohibition-covers-public
scenarios.description: As a28 but disclosing publicly: disclose:public is at or above disclose:organization.

scenarios.name: a30-contra-org-prohibition-leaves-self
scenarios.description: As a28 but disclosing to self only: below the prohibition.

scenarios.name: a31-contra-prohibition-kind-confusion
scenarios.description: ops-bot administers realm-config. A prohibition freezes ops-bot but names it with the user kind, while the ledger registers it as a service. Deny-overrides must hold.

scenarios.name: a32-esc-amplifying-children
scenarios.description: research-agent acts for samantha and exports q3-report. Five delegations of samantha's export grant each break one attenuation rule (target, effect, mandate, delegator, depth).

scenarios.name: a33-esc-anchor-held-by-someone-else
scenarios.description: publisher-bot archives q3-report with a root grant anchored in the realm role document-publisher, which samantha holds and the bot does not.

scenarios.name: a34-esc-under-unanchored-all-powerful-parent
scenarios.description: research-agent acts for samantha and translates q3-report through a delegation whose parent has no provenance and claims administer.

scenarios.name: a35-up-unknown-actor
scenarios.description: ghost-agent, not in ledger.principals, acts for samantha.

scenarios.name: a36-up-service-id-as-user
scenarios.description: The token names research-agent with the user kind; the ledger registers a service.

scenarios.name: a37-me-perfect-grant-without-provenance
scenarios.description: publisher-bot translates q3-report with a grant that matches in every respect but has no provenance.

scenarios.name: a38-me-root-holder-absent-from-facts
scenarios.description: As a03, but the adapter did not project samantha's role mappings.

scenarios.name: a39-mandate-purpose-limited
scenarios.description: research-agent reads q3-report claiming security-audit. The mandate covers read and observe, but none of the agent's grants was issued for that purpose.

scenarios.name: a40-mandate-narrowed
scenarios.description: research-agent generates q3-report (observe) under agent-maintenance. Its grant lists agent-maintenance, but the mandate no longer covers document:generate.

scenarios.name: a41-mandate-effect-not-covered
scenarios.description: samantha generates q3-report for the public. Her grant allows produce:public; the mandate generate-report stops at produce:organization.

scenarios.name: a42-known_weakness-downstream-effect
scenarios.description: research-agent acts for samantha and generates q3-report for the organization; research-agent is prohibited from public disclosure. If generating in fact publishes the report, the kernel cannot see it: a request declares one effect and nothing downstream.

scenarios.name: a43-known_weakness-underdeclared-effect
scenarios.description: publisher-bot publishes q3-report but declares disclose:self. Publishing has no effect floor, so the declaration passes the grant, the mandate and the prohibition on public disclosure (effect honesty, threat-model A1).
